description: Runtime or smoke acknowledgement for a UE Experiment Console command. This file documents the contract; Scripts/UE5/check_ue_command_echo_contract.py implements active validation.
evidence_boundary: accepted or rejected rows are command acknowledgement evidence, not controller performance evidence.
Rows with source=offline_adapter_smoke must not be claimed as live UE console or runtime MWORKS/ROS2 evidence.
Forbidden pose commands are valid only when status=rejected and reason marks pose override as forbidden.
